channel.title: Wormifi Devlog
channel.description: Building a browser worm arena in public: design laws, trade-offs, and the shipping record.

item.title: A launcher about your captain, not our menus
item.description: The launcher redesign: one captain front and center, settings in the Captain's Quarters, visible turbo reserve with arena pickups, and the earnable Legend Voyage.

item.title: The Spacious Update: a bigger sea, a classic board, stacking multipliers
item.description: The arena grew to 2.7x its area, Honeycomb Cove joined the fleet, the mouse wheel zooms, multiplier tokens stack with no cap, and growth finally looks like growing.

item.title: Why one server decides every collision
item.description: The first architecture decision in a multiplayer worm arena: when two players disagree about a collision, who is right - and what server authority costs.

item.title: Nothing appears from nowhere: designing conserved mass
item.description: One design law decides how treasure drops, what cutting a rival pays, and why sprinting scatters your own size behind you.

item.title: Twelve skins that actually move
item.description: Replacing palette-swap skins with animated materials - flowing ribbons, traveling gleams, lightning - inside a strict frame budget.

item.title: The 60fps budget: performance as a contract
item.description: Every visual feature passes a 60-second crowded-arena gate before it ships: frame pacing, long tasks, memory growth.

item.title: Shipping a game with no app store
item.description: A signed Android package, iPhone home-screen install, offline solo play - the whole store pipeline without the store.

item.title: Skins stay cosmetic: our monetization line
item.description: What we will and will not sell, written down in public before the store opened: appearance yes, power never.

item.title: The Wormifi roadmap
item.description: What is live today and what is in the workshop - real character heads, a cosmetics store, sturdier live rooms - labeled honestly.

item.title: What shipped, and when
item.description: The public shipping record: boards, paces, friend rooms, animated materials, turbo, installs without an app store.
